up: For assay CHEMBL1614544, return the exact activity values and compound structures. Include the ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Use an exact match on the assay identifier and preserve all activity rows including those with missing values. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614544';
